heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for professional visual content creation—from text prompts, images, or scripts to polished images and synchronized video outputs.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a hero built as a premium creative-studio scene: the headline and CTAs sit on the left over a warm white-to-amber mesh gradient, while the right side is composed of layered product mockups, floating prompt chips, and offset preview frames that suggest image and video generation simultaneously. Keep the composition asymmetrical and expansive rather than a standard split hero. Use the brand accent #b3713f for the primary CTA and chip highlights, with soft-shadow cards and subtle motion on entrance. Add a logo trust band directly beneath the hero and carry decorative orbs/grid lines into one dark showcase section later in the page to satisfy contrast and depth.

repetitionBreakers: Start with a split visual hero, then switch to a compact logo trust band to avoid repeating the same layout energy.
Use a 3-step how-it-works section with icon-led cards after the hero to create a process rhythm before proof.
Make the proof section a logo grid, then shift to alternating product sections with one tabs-with-preview block and one split-panel-list block.
Use a single rich dark showcase band only for the video product section to break the otherwise light page flow.
Finish with a centered comparison-style pricing block and a floating lead form card to increase conversion tension without repeating hero structure.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro | AI Image & Video Generation for Creative Teams
blueprint.metaDescription: Explore Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance to generate high-quality AI images and videos with professional control, multimodal workflows, and trusted creative performance.

sections.backgroundTreatment: airy white base with warm accent chips, abstract-shape overlays, and layered depth shadows
sections.designNote: Hero is content-first but visually dynamic: headline answers what it is, subheadline clarifies who it is for, and the primary CTA is the only button label used across the page. Right side should show a premium collage of image and video generation previews, prompt chips, and overlapping UI frames to immediately communicate creative power.

Place a compact logo trust band immediately below the hero using 3-6 recognisable logos. Keep it clean and static, with no marquee motion. If logo availability is thin, replace with a restrained metrics strip, but the preferred decision is logo-first credibility because the traffic is warm and proof type is logos.

Introduce a 3-step process section as required by the warm-traffic sequence: prompt or upload, generate or refine, then export or share. Keep it tight and utility-led with three visually distinct cards so the page rhythm shifts from trust into action. This section should be lighter and more instructional than the hero.

Use a logo-led proof block with recognisable brand marks and a short supporting line that reinforces enterprise-grade confidence. Because the proof type is logos, keep this section visually simple but prominent. Do not overexplain; let the names do the work.

First product block should spotlight Seedream 4.5 using tabs with a preview panel because it has many features and the product is complex. Make the left side a feature rail with concise tabs for text-to-image, editing, multi-image composition, resolution, typography, and structural fidelity; the right side should preview outputs. This section should feel like a high-control creative tool rather than a generic feature list.

Second product block should switch sharply in tone: use the single dark showcase band here to break the page rhythm and elevate Seedance 1.5 Pro. Present a cinematic split-panel layout with motion previews, audio-video synchronization, lip-sync, camera control, and speed benefits. Keep the copy concise and the visuals expansive, with the CTA still reading only 'Get started'.

After the product blocks, isolate the two strongest click-driving capabilities in a spotlight-plus-grid section: one image-generation strength and one video-generation strength. This is the persuasive bridge between product detail and purchase intent, and it should be more editorial than technical.

Use a centered pricing comparison with two product cards, but keep the visual treatment refined rather than salesy. Since the warm traffic should end with 'See it in action over Sign up now', the pricing area should remain a guided step toward contact or demo rather than a hard checkout push. All buttons must still say 'Get started'.

Because there are 4+ testimonials, present them as a compact carousel or controlled slider. Use quote cards from creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads to reinforce role-specific trust. Keep the treatment polished and not overly dense.

Finish with a floating lead form card or demo request block as the final conversion step. Keep it minimal and focused, with the same CTA label everywhere: 'Get started'. On mobile, the CTA must be full-width. This section should feel like the last confident invitation rather than a heavy form wall.

Use a minimal credibility strip near the footer only if needed; do not use a moving marquee. Since the main trust signal is already handled above the fold, this section should stay subtle and utility-oriented. If not needed, it can be visually very light.

blueprint.designPersonality: A premium creative-studio landing page: airy, editorial, and visually intelligent, with warm brand accents, strong logo trust, layered depth, and conversion-first sections that make the AI models feel powerful yet approachable.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use large, premium product mockups and layered visual collages showing AI image generation, video generation, and editing workflows. The hero should feature a 3D-feel composition with overlapping preview frames, floating prompt chips, subtle depth shadows, and expanding image tiles. Add a dedicated gallery section with video thumbnails and motion previews to reinforce the audiovisual nature of Seedance 1.5 Pro. Logos should be the dominant proof signal in a compact trust band near the top and optionally repeated in a subtle strip near the footer.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and product-specific, so 56px keeps it impactful without overcrowding the hero.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width brand hero with logo at top-left, large centered-left headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact bullet list of value props. Visual emphasis comes from bold typography and strong contrast rather than imagery.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single prominent hero followed by a lead-capture form section, then stacked product-detail sections. Rhythm is linear and conversion-focused, with minimal narrative branching.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-first content card: white or light panel, defined border/shadow, rounded corners, compact spacing, headline plus form or feature content. Cards favor clarity over decoration.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA should be high-contrast and singular in the hero; secondary CTA is absent or de-emphasized. Downstream sections may use a simple request/demo CTA tied to specific products.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing pattern is present; pricing is not surfaced in the provided structure.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not visible in the provided reference; assume a minimal utility footer if needed.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Media is minimal in the visible hero; if used, it should be secondary to content, aligned to the left/top brand area, and kept simple rather than immersive.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked feature blocks with a section label, product name, strong headline, descriptive paragraph, then a list of capabilities. Each section should be self-contained and scannable, using progressive disclosure for detail density.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form section placed immediately after the hero. Form is presented in a framed card with a clear title and multiple hidden tracking fields, indicating a performance-marketing capture flow.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-oriented presentation with no visible motion patterns in the provided HTML.
designNotes: Keep the layout simple, direct, and enterprise-oriented.
Prioritize hierarchy through typography and spacing over imagery.
Use a single dominant CTA per screen to reduce friction.
Feature sections should be scannable with short labels and concise copy.
Maintain a clean, bordered-card system for forms and content blocks.

mustHaveMoments: Full-width dark hero with a bold 54px headline and concise value proposition
Prominent logo strip immediately after hero to establish trust first
Immersive product showcase using large 3D-feel expanding visuals or layered media
Dedicated gallery section featuring video previews to demonstrate Seedance capabilities
Separate, highly scannable feature sections for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro
Pricing or quote cards placed after value proof, with clear product-specific CTAs
Testimonials shown clearly in a visible grid without sliders or overlap
Minimal footer with utility links only
avoidPatterns: Do not use a black-only page with a weak banner-only first impression
Do not place a form and a competing media-heavy banner in the hero at the same time
Do not use thin strip-style sections that feel repetitive or visually narrow
Do not leave empty space beside small media assets; keep visuals balanced and large
Do not hide testimonials or place them in a slider if the layout is already grid-based
Do not allow overlapping content, numbered overlays, or cramped cards
Do not make the page overly decorative at the expense of clarity and conversion
designStrategy.reasoning: This is a category-style landing page for professional buyers who are evaluating advanced AI image and video generation tools. The strongest conversion path is demo booking, since the content emphasizes product capability, free evaluation, and quote-based pricing rather than self-serve checkout. Because the visitor is solution-aware, the page should lead with product clarity, then quickly prove capability through visuals, feature depth, and strong social proof. Trust must be logo-led as requested, so brand/logo credibility should dominate before testimonials or pricing. Visually, a dark futuristic system with immersive 3D-feel media fits the AI category and the audience, but the layout must stay conversion-focused, balanced, and highly scannable. The hero should prioritize the product experience over form friction, with a strong CTA and immediate trust markers.
